name: game-loop
description: 2D or 3D game loop. One playable slice, project assets, a playtest judge, and rollback.

interface.longDescription: Pick 2D or 3D once. Build one playable change, use files already in the project, judge the running game, and roll back only your own files if the slice got worse.
defaultPrompt: Use $game-2d and add one playable change
Use $game-3d and add one playable change
Use $game-judge on the running game before calling it done
